# Ridge

Frontier model benchmark ledger. Cite source URL and as-of date.

- Snapshot: 2026-10-06
- Index: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 (current AA version; the 4 Sept v4.2 rebase moved scores to a new scale, so not 1:1 with August 60s-scale rows)
- SWE-bench Verified: Vals stopped running new models on 1 Sept 2026, so its leader is out of date and newer models are blank.
- Board columns: AA Index, SWE-bench, CursorBench 4.0, Arena Elo, Terminal-Bench, AA Cyber Index
- AA Cyber Index: Artificial Analysis cyber-defense composite (CWE-Bench-AA, DeepsecBench-AA, CyberGym-E2E-AA). Several frontier models decline many tasks on safety grounds, so their low scores mostly reflect refusals. Score notes give each model's refusal read. Source: https://artificialanalysis.ai/evaluations/artificial-analysis-cyber-index
- JSON table: /api/ledger.json
- CSV table: /api/ledger.csv
- Catalog: /api/v1
- Leaderboard: /api/v1/leaderboard

Fix (2026-10-06): Terminal-Bench 2.1 rows rechecked against Vals' current board: Grok 4.7 73.41 (was 76.03), Muse Spark 1.3 72.29 (was 85 from an Artificial Analysis article). All other TB 2.1 rows match Vals.
Fix (2026-10-06): Terminal-Bench 2.1 source is Vals AI (https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/terminal-bench-2-1), not Artificial Analysis. Five scores moved from secondary sites to Vals' figures: GPT-5.6 Sol 85.77 (was 88.8), Grok 4.6 78.28 (was 88.4), Kimi K3 80.9 (was 88.3), Gemini 3.7 Flash 77.53 (was 85.8), Claude Fable 5 80.52 (was 84.3).
New model (2026-10-06): Mistral Large 4 (Mistral AI, new lab; mistral-large-4), public preview, closed until open weights ship (promised end of October). 1.05T MoE (49B active), 1M context, $1.36 / $4.18 per 1M tokens (half price for the first two weeks). AA 38 (Preview, reasoning), AA Cyber Index 50 (no tasks declined); no Arena+, CursorBench, Terminal-Bench, or SWE-bench yet.
News (2026-10-06): Mistral released a public preview of Mistral Large 4 ("Le Chonk"), a ~1T-parameter MoE (49B active) with image input and 1M context, $1.36 / $4.18 per 1M tokens (50% launch discount for two weeks). Weights due by end of October; license not named yet. Benchmark charts are Mistral's own claims. Source: https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-large-4
News (2026-10-05): Reflection AI announced Beam, a 501B-parameter (23B active) open-weight model; weights due later in October under Apache 2.0. Not on the board yet: no independent scores. Benchmark claims are Reflection's own. Source: https://reflection.ai/blog/introducing-beam
New column (2026-10-04): AA Cyber Index. Grok 4.7 56 (xhigh), GPT-6 Luna 53 (max), Muse Spark 1.3 44 (xhigh), Kimi K3 41, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 41, GPT-6 Sol 37, GLM-5.3 36, GPT-6 Astra 33, Claude Opus 5.5 29, Gemini 3.8 Flash 25, Claude Fable 5.1 25. GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Fable 5.1, and Gemini 3.8 Flash decline about a third of tasks on safety grounds. Other catalog models are blank.
New model (2026-09-30): Gemini 4 Argon (Google DeepMind, limited preview for Fairwind cyber defenders), intro $2 / $10 then $4 / $20 per 1M tokens, 1M output limit. AA 53, Arena+ 1525; no CursorBench, Terminal-Bench, or SWE-bench yet.
New model (2026-09-29): GPT-6.1 Sol (OpenAI, DevDay), $2 / $10 per 1M tokens, 1M context. AA 52, Arena+ 1516; no CursorBench, Terminal-Bench, or SWE-bench yet.
New model (2026-09-28): Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Anthropic, claude-sonnet-5-5), $2 / $10 per 1M tokens, 1M context. AA 56, CursorBench 4.0 55.5, Arena+ 1521, Vals Terminal-Bench 2.1 83.15; no SWE-bench yet.
News (2026-09-24): UN Security Council AI session (Altman and Amodei call for global standards; Trump rejects global AI regulation). China's CAC probes DeepSeek and Moonshot over alleged Claude distillation (Decrypt / The Information; follows Anthropic's 10 Sep threat report). First public-opinion ratings: Opus 5.5 4, GPT-6 Sol 3, GPT-6 Luna 3, Grok 4.7 3; earlier ratings unchanged. No board score changes. 23 Sep: METR Opus 5.5 eval; price-war desk note; ChatGPT Voice on Astra/Sol/Luna; SWE-Together audit; Vals Terminal-Bench Sol 83.15 / Luna 73.03. 22 Sep: Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol/Luna launches with first-party board scores.
